689:t_016:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You have done work worthy of the $$真徒$$ name. To reward you for it, I will show you a miracle.」

689:t_016:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is because I can do it that I bear the name of an $$御使い$$.」

689:t_016:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I will show you that power as well.」

689:t_017:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My will to resist... is fading away...」

689:t_017:3.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is this... the power of that man, Advent...?」

689:t_017:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No. This is awe.」

689:t_017:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Before overwhelming power... absolute power, human thought halts at its own powerlessness, and people can only weep, begging for forgiveness...」

689:t_017:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「This is something carved into your genes... In that sense, the $$烙印$$ is carved into all of humanity.」

689:t_017:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「So you were the ones who carved the $$烙印$$ after all...!」

689:t_017:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You can no longer resist. You can only obey my words.」

689:t_017:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit screwing with us...! This is nothing but hypnosis...!」

689:t_017:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is futile. Even a Reactor is not permitted to defy my will.」

689:t_017:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That should be obvious even from looking at $n, should it not?」

689:t_017:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But there is no need to worry. From now on, you will serve as my hands and feet and work for the salvation of the universe.」

689:t_017:17.en:
$n
「I won't... obey... words like that... damn it...」

689:t_017:18.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No... My consciousness is... growing distant... and I'm... fading...」

689:t_017:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「We can't win... can we...」

689:t_049:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's give it our all today too...!」

689:t_049:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

689:t_049:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thinking ahead to an emergency, I placed a suggestion on all of you.」

689:t_049:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You react to a keyword and take a specific action... Once this circuit was complete, the rest was easy. Now all of you will move exactly as I instruct.」

689:t_049:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So that was the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ business!」

689:t_049:14.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「To think everyone was being primed without our knowing...」

689:t_049:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was a struggle, you know. Steering all of you into speaking the keywords of your own accord.」

689:t_049:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, unless your psychological resistance is lowered, a $$バインドスペル$$ cannot be engraved.」

689:t_049:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But because I took my time, I succeeded in making it sink in deep and quiet. A miracle out of nowhere is nothing next to it.」

689:t_049:18.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バインドスペル$$... The suggestion used in the $$ＵＣＷ$$ to control Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$...」

689:t_049:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You need not worry anymore. From now on, I will do the controlling of all of you.」

689:t_049:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I do feel bad about it, but it is surely better than becoming puppets of the $$御使い$$s.」

689:t_049:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your anger at the emissary of God... and my thorough preparation are what produced this grand reversal.」

689:t_049:23.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「We are not angry only at $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

689:t_049:25.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You've got some nerve, pulling a stunt like manipulating our hearts!」

689:t_049:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A... Ahh... If you get that angry, the effect of the $$バインドスペル$$ will...!」

689:t_018:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Don't worry about needless things, AG!」

689:t_018:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Thanks to you, that kind of thing will never work on us again!」

689:t_018:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Just so you know, it's not because of your $$バインドスペル$$'s power!」

689:t_018:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You made us angry... That is the power.」

689:t_018:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「We won't obey. Not you, and not the $$御使い$$s.」

689:t_018:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-Well, be that as it may, the one person who hasn't registered a $$バインドスペル$$ still seems to be in a pinch...」

689:t_018:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's as much trouble as ever!」

689:t_018:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「Pull yourself together, $n! You've got a big job waiting for you from here on, right!」

689:t_018:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hurry up and do it! $$クロウ$$, $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$ are waiting too!」

689:t_018:13.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「It's all right now, $n. Come, let us be enfolded by Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ together.」

689:t_018:15.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You're the one who should be quiet. $n belongs to me and Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

689:t_019:0.en:
$n
「My life, which Mom protected, Dad and Sis raised, and my friends supported, is my own!」

689:t_019:1.en:
$n
「I won't hand over being myself to anyone!」

689:t_019:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's now or never! Sync the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ with the $$スフィア$$!」

真徒.evidence: glossary keyword (proposed); used as token in t_016:3

uncertain: 689:t_016:3: 真徒 rendered with glossary keyword token $$真徒$$ ('True Disciple', proposed entry) as 'the $$真徒$$ name'; addressed to the True Disciple who called Advent (rows in 2099_09).
689:t_016:6/t_049:20/t_018:4: 御使い = token $$御使い$$ (glossary 'Angel'), 'an $$御使い$$' singular for Advent's own title, '$$御使い$$s' plural elsewhere.
689:t_017:1: Rand's こいつは…！ = 'This is...!' (reused 'This one...!' does not fit here).
689:t_017:9/t_017:10: 烙印（スティグマ） rendered only with token $$烙印$$ (Stigma); the furigana-style gloss is not repeated.
689:t_018:8: Sousuke's 相変わらず世話の焼ける奴だ rendered third person 'He's as much trouble as ever!' (Hibiki is male; could be addressed to him).
689:t_018:13/15: White's アドヴェント様 = 'Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$' matching her earlier rows.
689:t_049:18: エーデル・ベルナル准将 = 'Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$' (the female UCW Edel, per glossary gender).
689:t_049:22: 神の使い = 'emissary of God' (not the 御使い token); 689:t_049:13 Ｄトレーダーのあれ = 'that $$Ｄトレーダー$$ business'.
689:t_019:0: Hibiki's 父さん/姉さん = 'Dad'/'Sis' (Mom per settled rendering).
